title: fix(update): retain completion errors without a lint suppression
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Hourly 37292375323 failed `test/scripts/lint-suppressions.test.ts` in job 111705914349 because #165340 (2faa6a047fc2) introduced a 79th suppression in the update command runner, outside the existing 78-entry inventory.

This is a lint regression; both original errors were already retained. Capture the reporting failure before composing the final error: the command failure remains the primary `cause`, and `AggregateError.errors` retains both failures. Reporting-only failures retain their original identity, including non-Error thrown values. Successful updates, rollback behavior, and the suppression inventory stay unchanged.

## Validation

- Reproduced the original inventory failure locally: 1 failed, 2 passed; candidate: 3 passed (9.27 s).
- Local full files: update-runner-command (4 passed, 55.15 s including cold worker compilation), update-runner (4 passed, 25.38 s), update-command-run (46 passed, 72.24 s), update-command-package-doctor (19 passed, 45.93 s).
- Formatting, targeted type-aware lint, and boundary lint passed.
- `check-changed` passed core types, all 27 dependent test type graphs, and the preceding static guards. Its unused-export scan failed on eight production and five full-tree entries in unrelated files; the exact same findings reproduced with this patch removed at base 6ddf5a6106c1. No suppressions or baselines were added. All nine remaining guards passed, including targeted lint and runtime import cycles.
- Independent P2 review completed scoped-clean.

Linux proof was requested through Blacksmith Testbox. Lease `tbx_01m45t1eahx7np91k27nfzj2fm` timed out after 15 minutes queued, without executing the payload, and was stopped. This ready PR uses the authorized congestion fallback so natural PR CI can cover the remaining Linux updater-family proof. No workflow reruns or repository settings changes were made.
